info.name: Retrieve detailed customer data of a single customer

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Customer identifier. Using an external ID is not supported.

items.docs: Retrieves a customer by customer ID and returns the data associated with the customer.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offsets the starting position in the sorted result set. Used for pagination together with the `limit` query parameter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Sets the maximum number of items to return from the sorted result set. Used for pagination together with the `offset` query parameter.

params.name: filter
params.description: Use the supported fields and operators to filter the results.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorts results by one or more fields in the specified order. Each field can be used only once.
When multiple sort instructions are provided, the first field is used as the primary sort field. Each additional field determines the order of results that have the same value for the preceding field.
Example: `?sort[0][field]=status&sort[0][direction]=asc&sort[1][field]=created_at&sort[1][direction]=desc`

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of customers, including standard customer fields and any custom customer attributes configured in the workspace.
Results can be filtered and sorted by `created_at` and `status` customer attribute values.

Returns a paginated list of transactions registered for the customer, including their items, associated events, point values, and current processing status.
Results can be filtered and sorted by `status`, `checkout_date`, `auto_accept`, `account`, `points_rewarded`, `earned`, and `burned` transaction attribute values.
